network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPACAL ricostruisce l'evento pluviometrico del 2-5 maggio nel bacino del Trionto e documenta le piogge a Longobucco, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata del fiume associabili al ponte. La pioggia non viene convertita in idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPACAL report reconstructs the 2-5 May rainfall event in the Trionto basin and documents rainfall at Longobucco, but publishes no river stage or discharge attributable to the bridge. Rainfall is not converted into hydrometry.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
